fusions.name: Sounding Cluck
fusions.desc: Clucks a pulse of sound that strikes the first enemy in line for 4 damage, with a 25% chance to leave it [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Roost Shriek
fusions.desc: Shrieks the roost awake, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning them for 1.2 seconds. The effect grows 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

fusions.name: Night Flit
fusions.desc: Your dodge chance rises by 20% for 10 seconds, and you jink 3 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Dusk Perch
fusions.desc: At night, your armour rises by 10%.
